data.name: Exploratory Bone Health and Lipid Metabolism Objective
data.text: To evaluate the effect of LY4395089 on bone health and lipid metabolism in participants with CD

data.name: Exploratory Pharmacodynamic Objective
data.text: To evaluate the pharmacodynamic effects of LY4395089 in participants with CD

data.name: Exploratory Bone Health Biomarkers Endpoint
data.text: Change from baseline at Week 12 of Study Period 1 and Week 40 of Study Period 2 in the following bone health biomarkers: CTX-1, PTH, P1NP, 25-OH-vitamin D, Bone-specific alkaline phosphatase

data.name: Exploratory Bone Mineral Density Endpoint
data.text: Change from baseline at Week 12 of Study Period 1 for bone mineral density

data.name: Exploratory Lipid Metabolism Endpoint
data.text: Change from baseline at Week 12 of Study Period 1 of Total cholesterol, TG, Non-HDL cholesterol, LDL, HDL

data.name: Exploratory Pharmacodynamic Biomarkers Endpoint
data.text: Change from baseline at Week 12 of Study Period 1 in the following biomarkers: 7AlphaC4, FGF19

data.name: Primary Efficacy Estimand
data.populationSummary: Adult participants with moderately to severely active Crohn's Disease meeting eligibility criteria as defined in the IIBD master protocol (Intent-to-Treat (ITT) Population as defined in the IIBD master protocol) Summary measure: As defined in the IIBD master protocol.

intercurrentEvents.text: Participant discontinues LY4395089 and/or mirikizumab before the primary endpoint assessment

intercurrentEvents.name: Use of prohibited concomitant medication

intercurrentEvents.name: Non-responder at Week 12
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant does not achieve endoscopic response or clinical response (by CDAI) at Week 12 of Study Period 1 and does not transition to Study Period 2

data.analysisPopulation: Intent-to-Treat (ITT) Population as defined in the IIBD master protocol

data.summaryMeasure: As defined in the IIBD master protocol

data.name: Exploratory Bone Health Biomarkers Estimand
data.populationSummary: Adult participants with moderately to severely active Crohn's Disease randomized to LY4395089/mirikizumab co-administration or mirikizumab, with available bone health biomarker assessments at Week 12 of Study Period 1 and Week 40 of Study Period 2 (All Randomized Participants with available biomarker data (Exploratory Analysis Population)) Summary measure: Descriptive statistics of change from baseline; difference in least squares means may be applied as specified in the SAP.

intercurrentEvents.name: Discontinuation of LY4395089
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant discontinues LY4395089 before the Week 12 or Week 40 biomarker assessment

intercurrentEvents.name: Missing biomarker sample
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant does not provide a biomarker sample at the scheduled assessment visit

intercurrentEvents.name: Use of vitamin D or calcium supplementation
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant initiates or changes vitamin D or calcium supplementation during the study, which may confound bone health biomarker assessments

data.treatment: LY4395089/mirikizumab co-administration compared with mirikizumab alone in terms of effect on bone health biomarkers (CTX-1, PTH, P1NP, 25-OH-vitamin D, Bone-specific alkaline phosphatase)
data.analysisPopulation: All Randomized Participants with available biomarker data (Exploratory Analysis Population)
data.variableOfInterest: Change from baseline at Week 12 of Study Period 1 and Week 40 of Study Period 2 in bone health biomarkers: CTX-1, PTH, P1NP, 25-OH-vitamin D, and Bone-specific alkaline phosphatase
data.summaryMeasure: Descriptive statistics of change from baseline; difference in least squares means may be applied as specified in the SAP

data.name: Exploratory Bone Mineral Density Estimand
data.populationSummary: Adult participants with moderately to severely active Crohn's Disease randomized to LY4395089/mirikizumab co-administration or mirikizumab, with available DXA scan assessments at baseline and Week 12 of Study Period 1 (All Randomized Participants with available DXA scan data (Exploratory Analysis Population)) Summary measure: Descriptive statistics of change from baseline; difference in least squares means may be applied as specified in the SAP.

intercurrentEvents.name: Discontinuation of LY4395089 before Week 12 DXA scan
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant discontinues LY4395089 before the Week 12 DXA scan assessment

intercurrentEvents.name: Missing DXA scan at Week 12
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant does not complete the DXA scan at Week 12 of Study Period 1

intercurrentEvents.name: Initiation of bone-modifying therapy
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant initiates bone-modifying therapy (e.g., bisphosphonates) during Study Period 1, which may confound bone mineral density assessments

data.treatment: LY4395089/mirikizumab co-administration compared with mirikizumab alone in terms of effect on bone mineral density as measured by DXA scan
data.analysisPopulation: All Randomized Participants with available DXA scan data (Exploratory Analysis Population)
data.variableOfInterest: Change from baseline at Week 12 of Study Period 1 for bone mineral density as assessed by DXA scan
data.summaryMeasure: Descriptive statistics of change from baseline; difference in least squares means may be applied as specified in the SAP

data.name: Exploratory Lipid Metabolism Estimand
data.populationSummary: Adult participants with moderately to severely active Crohn's Disease randomized to LY4395089/mirikizumab co-administration or mirikizumab, with available fasting lipid assessments at baseline and Week 12 of Study Period 1 (All Randomized Participants with available fasting lipid data (Exploratory Analysis Population)) Summary measure: Descriptive statistics of change from baseline; difference in least squares means may be applied as specified in the SAP.

intercurrentEvents.name: Discontinuation of LY4395089 before Week 12 lipid assessment
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant discontinues LY4395089 before the Week 12 fasting lipid assessment

intercurrentEvents.name: Non-fasting status at lipid assessment visit
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant is not fasting at the time of the Week 12 lipid sample collection as required per protocol

intercurrentEvents.name: Initiation of lipid-modifying therapy
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant initiates lipid-modifying therapy (e.g., statins, fibrates) during Study Period 1, which may confound lipid metabolism assessments

data.treatment: LY4395089/mirikizumab co-administration compared with mirikizumab alone in terms of effect on fasting lipid parameters (Total cholesterol, TG, Non-HDL cholesterol, LDL, HDL)
data.analysisPopulation: All Randomized Participants with available fasting lipid data (Exploratory Analysis Population)
data.variableOfInterest: Change from baseline at Week 12 of Study Period 1 in fasting lipid parameters: Total cholesterol, TG, Non-HDL cholesterol, LDL, and HDL
data.summaryMeasure: Descriptive statistics of change from baseline; difference in least squares means may be applied as specified in the SAP

data.name: Exploratory Pharmacodynamic Biomarkers Estimand
data.populationSummary: Adult participants with moderately to severely active Crohn's Disease randomized to LY4395089/mirikizumab co-administration or mirikizumab, with available pharmacodynamic biomarker assessments at baseline and Week 12 of Study Period 1 (All Randomized Participants with available pharmacodynamic biomarker data (Exploratory Analysis Population)) Summary measure: Descriptive statistics of change from baseline; geometric mean ratio or difference in least squares means on log-transformed scale may be applied as specified in the SAP.

intercurrentEvents.name: Discontinuation of LY4395089 before Week 12 PD assessment
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant discontinues LY4395089 before the Week 12 pharmacodynamic biomarker assessment

intercurrentEvents.name: Missing pharmacodynamic biomarker sample
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant does not provide a blood sample for 7AlphaC4 or FGF19 at the scheduled Week 12 assessment visit

intercurrentEvents.name: Use of bile acid sequestrants or FXR-modulating agents
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant initiates use of bile acid sequestrants or other agents known to modulate FXR pathway during Study Period 1, which may confound pharmacodynamic biomarker assessments

data.treatment: LY4395089/mirikizumab co-administration compared with mirikizumab alone in terms of pharmacodynamic effects on FXR pathway biomarkers (7AlphaC4 and FGF19)
data.analysisPopulation: All Randomized Participants with available pharmacodynamic biomarker data (Exploratory Analysis Population)
data.variableOfInterest: Change from baseline at Week 12 of Study Period 1 in pharmacodynamic biomarkers: 7AlphaC4 (7alpha-hydroxy-4-cholesten-3-one) and FGF19 (fibroblast growth factor 19)
data.summaryMeasure: Descriptive statistics of change from baseline; geometric mean ratio or difference in least squares means on log-transformed scale may be applied as specified in the SAP
